annotations.noesis-knowledge-engine.command_intake_m: The legacy stem table attributes no pack to noesis-knowledge-engine tools; the plan attributes the tool to the packs that consume it and the pack that contributes its provider. Expected: attribution now comes from the plan (C04.1).

The reference catalog is built without a warehouse connection. The composition probe observes that the owning store is not configured and reports the provider unavailable; the legacy table evaluates only scopes and pack flags. With a configured warehouse the probe reports the store's real readiness (see test_catalog_composition and the C08 acceptance suite).
